picked_rationale.C2: C2 (Belief Heads Localization) is the crown-jewel mechanistic claim of the paper — it establishes the H* head sets that are directly inherited by C3 (checkpoint analysis uses C2's H* unchanged) and C4 (the controller amplifies C2's H*). Without C2's localization result, C3 and C4 lose their mechanistic grounding. C1 is a behavioral-only claim. C2 is the only claim that demonstrates a causal mechanism (Fisher-masked zero-ablation) isolating distinct neural circuits, making it the most load-bearing claim for the paper's core thesis that 'personal and attributed belief are implemented by distinct causally-separable attention-head circuits.' Independent importance judgment fully concurs with orchestrator's prior read.
